aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misgroups loader-coil insert settings, machines, and normal comparison conditions.
issues: Changed factor mixes insert positions, Z-axis values, and machine summary rows.
Baseline/test condition is not reliably defined from the report context.
Subgroup keys are numeric settings, not preserved row grouping keys.
Measurement outcomes cite header rows only and appear derived, not direct comparisons.
Function-check rows are incomplete in context and may need grouped paired rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the primary comparison adjusted AWF #1 vs normal line, or each loader-coil insert setting vs normal?
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor from purpose/content rows as loader coil insert adjustment/setting comparison.
Preserve machine, date/time block, insert position, and Z-axis as subgroup keys.
Remove machine total rows from condition lists or label them as summaries.
Use actual data rows for visual/forming and function outcomes, not only header/stat rows.
Separate or clearly group coil forming and function lot checks under the same corrected factor.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
